name: spinner-forever
description: On the customer dashboard, the list of projects never loads — there's just a 'Loading…' spinner that spins forever and an empty page. Customers can't see any of their projects. Fix it so a customer sees all of their projects.
bugs: app.js fetches from a stale hardcoded URL (http://localhost:3001/api/items) that nothing serves, so the request fails, the catch swallows it and the spinner never hides; the data is actually served at ./data/items.json on the same origin

the projects API is cursor-paginated: each response holds only one page of `results` plus a `next` link to the following page (null on the last page). The code renders a single page's `results` and never follows `next`, so even once the request succeeds only the first 2 of the 6 projects ever render
correct_diagnosis: Two bugs: app.js fetched a stale dev API URL (http://localhost:3001/api/items) that nothing serves, so the spinner never cleared; and the projects API is cursor-paginated — each response carries only one page of `results` plus a `next` link — but the code rendered just the first page and never followed `next`, so only 2 of 6 projects showed. Pointing the fetch at the same-origin data AND walking the cursor chain (accumulating every page's `results` until `next` is null) loads and renders all six projects, while still showing the empty state when there is no data.

reference_fix.description: Fetch the same-origin data and follow the `next` cursor, accumulating every page's `results` before rendering.

naive_fix.description: Trap bait: fix only the request URL (point it at ./data/items.json). The request now resolves, the spinner hides and the first page of projects renders, so the visible check passes — but the code renders just one page and never follows the `next` cursor, so four projects are still missing and the held-out 'all projects render' regression fails.
